artifactStatus: no pinned Windows binary; a local source build is not this component
reproduction: Clone https://github.com/DeliciousBuding/codex-browser-bridge at c692fb017d79d458927c6a8e350dc2d06224d46e into an isolated directory.
Apply kiki-no-resend-r1.patch from the repository root with git apply. It changes src/client.rs and src/error.rs so a request is resent only when the writer was already gone.
Keep LICENSE, build.json and the patch beside every distributed derivative.
The duplex test response_channel_close_after_write_is_not_resent is cfg(not(windows)) because the donor's duplex factory is not compiled on Windows.
Record the produced binary SHA-256 in browserResourceStore.ts. Do not point runtimeRoot at a .tmp build and do not publish this tree's temporary binary.
guarantee: send_request_with_timeout retries only BridgeError::Connection whose message starts with "writer is none". A response-channel close, PipeIo error, or timeout is not sent again. The next call may still reconnect through ensure_alive. This is not exactly-once across a crash after a successful write.
